newsitem.title: INDIA: Laos premier Siphandone to visit India.
newsitem.headline: Laos premier Siphandone to visit India.

text.p: The prime minister of Laos, Khamtay Siphandone, will start a five-day visit to India on Thursday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Wednesday.
Siphandone will be the first foreign head of state to meet Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral since Gujral assumed office on April 21, PTI said.

The two nations will explore the possibilities of improving cooperation in agriculture, transport, hydro-electric power, irrigation, human resource development, health and mining, the news agency reported.

Siphandone is also scheduled to meet the Indian president and the vice president. He will later visit the southern city of Bangalore and stop over for one day at Calcutta to hold talks with Jyoti Basu, the state chief of West Bengal, PTI said.
